ComparePlaybooks.description_en: Compares the configurations of two published playbook versions
ComparePlaybooks.description_zh: 用于比较发布的两个版本的剧本配置信息

ConvertPlaybook.description_en: Converts the playbook flowchart configuration format from XML to X6. This operation is used for backward compatibility with historical data. Earlier versions used the XML format for playbook configuration, which was later changed to the X6 format
ConvertPlaybook.description_zh: 转换剧本流程图配置格式，由xml转为x6。用于兼容历史数据，早期版本中配置剧本使用的xml格式，之后改为了x6格式

CreatePlaybook.description_zh: 用于创建一个初始化的剧本

DeleteComponentAsset.description_en: Deletes the asset information of a component configuration
DeleteComponentAsset.description_zh: 用于删除组件配置的资产信息

DeletePlaybook.description_zh: 用于删除指定的自定义剧本

DescribeComponentAssetForm.description_en: Obtains the metadata for a component asset, which defines the fields that constitute the asset
DescribeComponentAssetForm.description_zh: 用于获取组件的资产元信息，即资产信息是由哪些字段组成的

DescribeComponentAssets.description_en: Retrieves the asset list for a component
DescribeComponentAssets.description_zh: 用于获取某一组件的资产信息列表

DescribeComponentList.description_en: Retrieves a list of standard components that you can use
DescribeComponentList.description_zh: 用于获取用户可使用的普通组件的列表

DescribeComponentPlaybook.description_en: Retrieves a list of predefined components
DescribeComponentPlaybook.description_zh: 用于获取用户可以使用的预定义组件列表

DescribeComponentsJs.description_en: Obtains the JavaScript (JS) file that a component uses to render the page
DescribeComponentsJs.description_zh: 用于获取组件的JS文件，组件会以返回的JS文件来进行页面的渲染

DescribeDistinctReleases.description_en: Retrieves a list of distinct playbook releases
DescribeDistinctReleases.description_zh: 获取去重后的剧本发布的版本信息列表

DescribeEnumItems.description_en: Queries the enumeration information for a product
DescribeEnumItems.description_zh: 用于获取产品需要的一些枚举信息

DescribeExecutePlaybooks.description_en: Queries a list of executable playbooks that are used to configure automated response plans
DescribeExecutePlaybooks.description_zh: 用于配置自动响应计划时，获取可执行的剧本列表

DescribeField.description_en: Retrieves global configuration information for the product
DescribeField.description_zh: 用于获取产品全局的，通用的配置信息

DescribeGroupProductions.description_en: Retrieves the group list of Alibaba Cloud products
DescribeGroupProductions.description_zh: 获取阿里云产品的分组列表信息

DescribeLatestRecordSchema.description_en: Describes the output structure of each node in a playbook based on the latest execution record
DescribeLatestRecordSchema.description_zh: 用于根据剧本最新一次的执行记录，动态生成剧本各节点的输出结构信息

DescribeNodeParamTags.description_en: Returns the reference paths for component inputs in a playbook orchestration
DescribeNodeParamTags.description_zh: 用于编排剧本时，组件输入的可引用路径

DescribeNotifyTemplateList.description_en: Queries the list of notification message templates
DescribeNotifyTemplateList.description_zh: 查询通知消息模版列表

DescribeOpenApiInfo.description_en: Retrieves the details of a product API

DescribeOpenApiList.description_en: Retrieves the list of API operations for a product

DescribePlaybook.description_en: Retrieves the XML configuration of a playbook
DescribePlaybook.description_zh: 用于获取剧本的xml配置信息

DescribePlaybookInputOutput.description_en: Retrieves the input and output parameter configurations for a playbook
DescribePlaybookInputOutput.description_zh: 用于获取剧本的输入参数与输出参数的配置信息

DescribePlaybookMetrics.description_en: Queries playbook metadata, including its name, description, number of runs, and failure rate
DescribePlaybookMetrics.description_zh: 获取某一剧本的元信息，包括名字、描述、运行次数、失败率等

DescribePlaybookNodesOutput.description_en: Retrieves the historical output data of a component
DescribePlaybookNodesOutput.description_zh: 用于获取组件输出的历史数据

DescribePlaybookNumberMetrics.description_en: Retrieves metrics for the response orchestration product, including the total number of playbooks and the number of enabled playbooks
DescribePlaybookNumberMetrics.description_zh: 用于获取响应编排产品的统计信息，包含剧本数量、启用数量等内容

DescribePlaybookReleases.description_en: Queries a list of published versions of a playbook
DescribePlaybookReleases.description_zh: 用于获取剧本发布的线上版本的信息列表

DescribePopApi.description_en: Retrieves the details of an OpenAPI

DescribeProcessTaskCount.description_en: Queries the count of response tasks associated with an entity UUID
DescribeProcessTaskCount.description_zh: 通过实体UUID查询关联的处置任务数

DescribeProcessTasks.description_en: Retrieves the list of disposal tasks
DescribeProcessTasks.description_zh: 用于获取处置任务的列表信息

DescribeSoarRecordActionOutputList.description_en: Retrieves the output data generated by a component for an action in a playbook task
DescribeSoarRecordActionOutputList.description_zh: 用于获取剧本任务中，某一组件执行动作时，输出的数据列表

DescribeSoarRecordInOutput.description_en: Retrieves the input and output data of a component action after a playbook task is executed
DescribeSoarRecordInOutput.description_zh: 当用户执行剧本任务后，通过该接口可获取组件动作的输入数据与输出数据

DescribeSoarRecords.description_en: Queries the execution records for a playbook
DescribeSoarRecords.description_zh: 用于获取剧本的执行记录列表

DescribeSoarTaskAndActions.description_en: Retrieves the component execution records for a single playbook run
DescribeSoarTaskAndActions.description_zh: 用于获取剧本的一次运行过程中，组件的执行记录列表

DescribeSophonCommands.description_en: Queries the commands that are used to manage entities
DescribeSophonCommands.description_zh: 用于获取处置实体的命令

DescribeVendorApiList.description_en: Queries the list of OpenAPIs from cloud vendors

DescriberPython3ScriptLogs.description_en: After you submit a task for a Python 3 script, use the returned requestUuid to retrieve the operational logs
DescriberPython3ScriptLogs.description_zh: 在提交pyhton脚本的任务后，通过返回的requestUuid来获取运行日志

ModifyComponentAsset.description_en: You can call this operation to modify the asset information for a component
ModifyComponentAsset.description_zh: 当一个组件需要配置资产时，该接口用户修改组件的资产信息

ModifyPlaybook.description_en: Modifies the configuration of a playbook
ModifyPlaybook.description_zh: 用于修改剧本的配置信息

ModifyPlaybookInputOutput.description_en: Modifies the input and output parameters of a playbook
ModifyPlaybookInputOutput.description_zh: 用于修改剧本的输入参数与输出参数

PublishPlaybook.description_en: Publishes a playbook. Once published, the playbook runs with the new logic
PublishPlaybook.description_zh: 用于把剧本配置发布线上，发布后，剧本会以新的逻辑来运行

QueryTreeData.description_en: Retrieves a list of all playbooks
QueryTreeData.description_zh: 用于一次性获取所有的剧本列表

RevertPlaybookRelease.description_en: Rolls back a playbook to a specified version. You can also specify whether to publish the version during the rollback
RevertPlaybookRelease.description_zh: 用于回滚剧本到指定的版本，同时可以指定回滚时是否发布该版本

RunNotifyComponentWithEmail.description_en: Sends a message by using the email notification component
RunNotifyComponentWithEmail.description_zh: 执行通知组件-email发送消息

RunNotifyComponentWithMessageCenter.description_en: Executes the notification component to send a message through Message Center
RunNotifyComponentWithMessageCenter.description_zh: 执行通知组件-消息中心发送消息

RunNotifyComponentWithWebhook.description_en: Sends a message by using the notification component webhook
RunNotifyComponentWithWebhook.description_zh: 执行通知组件-webhook发送消息

RunPython3Script.description_en: Submits and executes a Python 3 code snippet. This operation can only be used for data processing
RunPython3Script.description_zh: 用于提交一段python3的代码片段并执行，只能用于数据处理

TriggerPlaybook.description_en: Triggers an enabled custom playbook or predefined playbook
TriggerPlaybook.description_zh: 用于触发已启用的自定义剧本或预定义剧本

TriggerProcessTask.description_en: When an event is handled using response orchestration, the response center creates a task. Perform follow-up actions on the task, such as unblocking, retrying a block, and removing from isolation
TriggerProcessTask.description_zh: 用户在使用响应编排的功能进行事件处置时，处置中心会生成相应的处置任务，该接口用于对生成的处置任务执行后续的解除封禁、重试封禁、解除隔离等动作

TriggerSophonPlaybook.description_en: Triggers a playbook or response command
TriggerSophonPlaybook.description_zh: 用于触发运行剧本或响应命令

VerifyPlaybook.description_en: Validates whether the playbook configuration is correct and whether the orchestration logic is reasonable
VerifyPlaybook.description_zh: 校验剧本的配置是否正确，编排的逻辑是否合理

VerifyPythonFile.description_en: Verifies the syntax of a Python code snippet
VerifyPythonFile.description_zh: 校验Python代码片段的语法是否正确
